name: services/crstests/groups
description: If a root of a test has limit_to_groups parameter set then this method will return the groups the test is limited to, otherwise it will return all the groups of the course edition the test is connected to. The root_id you supply must be an ID of a test which is connected to some course edition.

arguments.name: root_id
arguments.description: ID of a root of a test (this test must be a template).

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
List of the dictionaries of the following structure:
  • course_unit_id - unit_id
  • group_number - group_number
